records.title: Dwarka Expressway Turning Into Delhi-NCR’s New Residential Power Corridor, Prices Up 135 Per Cent Since 2021, Says Report
records.description: According to Anarock Research & Advisory’s September 2026 report, residential prices along Dwarka Expressway have risen 135 per cent since 2021, from around Rs 6,032 per sq ft to Rs 14,180 per sq ft in H1 2026. The appreciation is among the strongest recorded by any residential corridor in India. Prices are also now higher than Gurugram’s average of Rs 13,350 per sq ft in H1 2026. Infrastructure could provide the next leg of growth. The proposed Gurugram Metro extension towards Dwarka Expressway, completion of UER-II and the development of the 1,000-acre Global City Gurugram are expected to improve connectivity and create additional employment-led housing demand. Dwarka Expressway has moved beyond being an infrastructure promise to becoming one of Gurugram’s most closely watched residential corridors, with strong price appreciation, premium housing demand and a growing ecosystem of connectivity and social infrastructure reshaping the micro-market.

records.title: India’s construction costs climb up to 14% as retail and luxury housing fuel escalation
records.description: India’s construction sector is seeing sharper cost pressures, with overall project expenses rising as much as 14% amid stronger demand from retail and luxury housing segments, according to a new market report. The surge is being driven by elevated prices for materials, labour and execution, while developers continue to face tighter cost controls across active projects. Premium residential developments and shopping destinations are emerging as the main contributors to the upward trend, reflecting healthier offtake in higher-value real estate categories. For builders and investors, the shift signals a market where premium and consumption-led assets remain resilient even as input costs rise. The report highlights how construction inflation is reshaping project viability, pricing strategies and the pace of new launches across major urban markets.

records.title: India’s Construction Costs Climb as Premium Retail and Luxury Projects Face Up to 14% Inflation
records.description: India’s construction sector is seeing a steep rise in project costs, with retail and luxury developments among the hardest hit. Rising prices of key materials, tighter supply conditions and higher execution expenses are pushing overall construction budgets up by as much as 14%, according to the latest market update. The escalation is expected to influence pricing strategies, project timelines and developer margins across major urban markets. For corporates and investors, the trend underscores a growing preference for better-quality assets that can justify higher rents and long-term value. In real estate hubs such as NCR, the cost surge is likely to reinforce demand for premium, well-located commercial spaces and carefully planned mixed-use developments. Developers may increasingly pass on part of the burden to buyers and tenants, making value-led assets more attractive than ever.

records.title: CREDAI NCR-Ghaziabad Names Rakesh Kumar Agarwal as President in New Leadership Reshuffle
records.description: The CREDAI NCR-Ghaziabad chapter has elected a new leadership team, appointing Rakesh Kumar Agarwal as president in a move expected to strengthen industry coordination across the region. The updated executive body brings together a mix of experienced developers and professionals who will steer the association’s agenda on market growth, policy engagement and sectoral representation. The leadership transition comes at a time when NCR real estate is being shaped by infrastructure expansion, stronger end-user demand and a sharper focus on compliance. For developers and stakeholders, the new team is likely to play an important role in driving dialogue on project execution, buyer confidence and the region’s long-term housing and commercial outlook. The announcement also underscores Ghaziabad’s growing relevance within the wider NCR property market.

records.title: The Fast Lane To Delhi: How Connectivity Is Redrawing Indirapuram’s Housing Map
records.description: For years, buyers looking for high-end homes with good access to corporate hubs largely focused on Gurugram and select parts of Noida. That equation is beginning to change. Across the Hindon, Indirapuram is emerging as one of the areas benefiting from this shift. Indirapuram is no longer simply benefiting from Ghaziabad’s overall price movement. Its established premium locations are increasingly behaving like a market of their own. If demand for larger, lower-density luxury homes continues to rise alongside improving connectivity, Indirapuram may prove to be less of a suburban success story and more of an early indicator of how NCR’s housing map is being redrawn. Delhi-NCR’s premium housing map is changing, and this time the shift is being driven as much by connectivity as by developers and new projects.

records.title: Gurugram Drives NCR Housing Market, Demand Remains Resilient In Q2 2026
records.description: NCR launches dropped 40% year-on-year. Sales remained resilient despite lower supply. Gurugram led launches and housing sales. The residential real estate market in NCR has witnessed a significant slowdown in new housing supply during the second quarter of 2026. This can be noted even as homebuyer demand remains resilient, as per ANAROCK’s latest research on the quarterly real estate report. While developers have launched considerably fewer projects during the quarter, the housing sales have declined at a much slower pace. This reflects a sustained demand in the region. Housing Sales Jump 19% Across Top Nine Cities In Q2 2026 As Supply SurgesFresh residential launches in NCR have dropped by 40 per cent on a year-on-year basis, with unit launches dropping to 11,205 in Q2 of 2026. The data from the same quarter last year shows that a total of 18,760 units were launched.

records.title: How NCR’s Peripheral Belt Could Become Real Estate’s Next Hotspot With The Draft Regional Plan 2041
records.description: Peripheral NCR markets may see rapid growth. Smart townships planned across emerging corridors. Infrastructure projects to drive real estate demand. Real estate activity in India has seen significant changes in market development, from buyer preferences to emerging markets. These changes have started a domino effect. A major development is underway in Delhi NCR. The peripheral market may be on the verge of a bigger transformation if the Draft Regional Plan 2041 is implemented as it is envisioned. The announcement of the same was made by the National Capital Region Planning Board (NCRPB). As per Knight Frank India, the plan can alter the investment geography of northern India by shifting growth away from the dense and saturated Delhi-Gurugram-Noida core. The draft suggests a movement towards Haryana, Uttar Pradesh and Rajasthan. Rising Connectivity, Luxury Demand Push Delhi-NCR Home Prices HigherAt the core of this draft is a strategy that decentralises growth.

records.title: Infrastructure, Housing Projects Reshape Residential Landscape Along Gurugram’s Southern Peripheral Road
records.description: SPR emerging as premium residential destination. Infrastructure spending boosts real estate demand. Property prices rise over 18 per cent. The southern peripheral road (SPR) in Gurugram is undergoing a remarkable transformation. Once this was envisioned as a strategic connectivity link, the 16-kilometre corridor is becoming one of the most sought-after premium residential destinations in Delhi-National Capital Region (Delhi-NCR), driven by large-scale infrastructure investment matched with the end-user demand. Dwarka Expressway Drives Gurugram’s Luxury Housing Surge To Record HighsGurugram is strategically connected with Golf Course Extension Road, Sohna Road, and NH-48. SPR has evolved into an urban corridor that links residential neighbourhoods with key employment hubs, such as Cyber City and Udyog Vihar. This locational advantage has enhanced the appeal for homebuyers and investors who seek long-term value appreciation. Rising Connectivity, Luxury Demand Push Delhi-NCR Home Prices HigherA major catalyst behind SPR’s rise is the sustained focus on infrastructure development.

records.title: Dwarka Expressway Drives Gurugram’s Luxury Housing Surge To Record Highs
records.description: Gurugram leads India’s luxury housing market. Dwarka Expressway drives record transaction growth. Ultra-luxury sales touched Rs 24,120 crore. Gurugram has emerged as India’s fastest-growing luxury market, surpassing Mumbai in total sales value of ultra-premium homes, which are priced at Rs 10 crore and above. According to the latest High-end luxury housing report by India Sotheby’s International Realty and CRE Matrix, the NCR region has recorded Rs 24,120 crore worth of luxury home sales in the year 2025. This was a historic milestone for the market. Dwarka Expressway, Southern Peripheral Road And Beyond: The Corridors Fueling Gurugram’s Realty RiseThe report highlights that approximately 1,494 homes priced at Rs 10 crore were sold during the calendar year 2025. This is the highest number of ultra-luxury residential transactions ever recorded in Gurugram in a year alone. The city’s luxury housing segment has witnessed explosive growth in the last two years.

records.title: West Asia conflict may pressure delivery of over 5 lakh homes in 2026, says ANAROCK
records.description: The real estate sector could face fresh supply-chain and execution pressures in 2026 if the West Asia conflict continues to disrupt freight routes and material availability, according to ANAROCK. The firm estimates that delivery timelines for around 5.4 lakh homes may come under stress as developers navigate higher logistics costs, volatile commodity prices and possible delays in construction inputs. The warning comes at a time when India’s housing market is already balancing strong end-user demand with rising project complexity across major urban centres. Analysts say the impact may be most visible in large-format residential projects and ongoing developments where timely material movement is critical. While demand remains resilient in key markets, the conflict underscores how global geopolitical risks can quickly filter into domestic real estate execution and delivery schedules.

records.title: NCR Plan 2041 charts 8 new townships, aims to add room for 3 crore more residents
records.description: NCR Plan 2041 has proposed the development of eight new townships across the National Capital Region as part of a long-term strategy to absorb nearly 3 crore additional residents and ease pressure on existing urban centres. The plan also targets improved mobility, with a stated goal of enabling 30-minute travel between key nodes through stronger infrastructure and better regional connectivity. For the real estate sector, the proposal could unlock fresh land parcels for housing, commercial development and mixed-use projects, while also creating new investment avenues in emerging peripheral locations. If implemented effectively, the blueprint may reshape demand patterns across the NCR, support planned urban expansion and boost developer activity in areas positioned to benefit from future transport and infrastructure upgrades.

records.title: Mumbai Land Lease Drives Oberoi Realty’s Capital Deployment With ₹247 Crore First Tranche
records.description: Oberoi Realty has stepped up its expansion push in Mumbai after paying ₹247 crore as the first tranche for leasing 11 acres of prime land in Bandra, one of the city’s most valuable residential and commercial micro-markets. The transaction underlines continued developer interest in premium land parcels despite elevated acquisition costs, as firms look to secure inventory in supply-constrained locations with strong long-term demand. Bandra’s proximity to business hubs such as Bandra Kurla Complex, along with its established luxury housing profile, continues to keep the area attractive for high-value development. The deal also signals continued momentum in Mumbai’s elite real estate segment, where land access, redevelopment potential and future monetisation remain key investment drivers for major listed developers.

records.title: Mumbai Land Lease, Office Deals and Housing Sales Signal Another Strong Week for Realty
records.description: India’s real estate market continued to show strength this week, with major transactions across residential, commercial and land assets underscoring resilient demand in top urban centres. Developers and occupiers remained active in large-ticket deals, while housing sales momentum in premium projects signalled continued appetite among buyers despite broader economic uncertainty. The market also saw renewed interest in office leasing, land aggregation and long-tenure transactions, reflecting confidence in business expansion and mixed-use development opportunities. At the same time, recent regulatory and consumer-facing disputes reminded buyers and tenants to scrutinise legal terms, possession conditions and cancellation clauses before committing to property deals. Overall, the latest activity points to a property market that remains buoyant, particularly in established micro-markets where infrastructure, liquidity and brand-led developments continue to attract capital.

records.title: HT Real Estate roundup: market move, policy shifts and premium deal flow shape NCR housing outlook
records.description: Recent real estate updates point to continued momentum in India’s property markets, with premium commercial transactions, policy-driven regularisation measures and strong demand in select micro-markets. In the NCR context, Gurugram remains the region’s commercial and luxury housing bellwether, supported by high-value office leasing, upscale residential demand and sustained developer interest in large-format projects. Faridabad, meanwhile, continues to be the more affordable and infrastructure-led bet within the broader market, where policy support and improved connectivity typically drive buyer attention. Across cities, developers and institutions are still pursuing long-lease land deals, workspace expansion and premium launches, indicating that capital remains available for well-located assets despite a more cautious sentiment in some segments. The latest market tone suggests buyers and investors are becoming more selective, but quality supply in prime locations continues to command interest.

records.title: Mumbai’s Real Estate Market Sees a Wave of Big-Ticket Luxury and Commercial Deals
records.description: Mumbai’s property market continued to draw heavyweight capital this week, underscoring persistent demand for prime real estate in the city’s most expensive corridors. Among the notable transactions, Godrej Group chairperson Adi Godrej’s daughter Tanya Dubash and her firm bought two luxury sea-facing apartments in Worli for more than ₹294 crore, adding to the city’s recent run of high-value residential deals. In commercial real estate, NABARD acquired leasehold rights for a property in Bandra-Kurla Complex from MTNL for about ₹350.72 crore, while the National Stock Exchange entered into an 80-year lease for over 1 lakh sq ft of land in BKC for ₹1,684 crore. The transactions reflect continued appetite for premium assets in Mumbai, especially in established business districts and waterfront luxury micro-markets.

records.title: Plotted Projects Gain Ground in Bengaluru as Buyer Preference Shifts from Apartments to Land
records.description: Bengaluru’s residential market is showing a clear tilt toward plotted developments, with land-based projects accounting for nearly a third of all Q1 2026 registrations. The city recorded 32 plotted projects among 98 total registrations, up sharply from 17 in the same period last year. The rise suggests that more homebuyers are prioritising ownership of land over conventional apartments, a trend driven by stronger long-term appreciation, flexibility in construction and a growing appetite for independent living. The shift is also reshaping developer strategies, as plotted layouts emerge as a stronger product category in the city’s housing pipeline. With demand broadening across suburban growth corridors, the pattern points to sustained investor interest in real estate formats that combine capital value with control over future development.

records.title: Adani Group to invest nearly ₹1 lakh crore in Mumbai's Motilal Nagar redevelopment, says MHADA
records.description: Adani Group is set to invest nearly ₹1 lakh crore in the redevelopment of the 143-acre Motilal Nagar cluster in Goregaon, Mumbai, according to MHADA chief Sanjeev Jaiswal. The project is among the largest urban renewal opportunities in the country and is expected to generate about 17 lakh sq m of area for sale, underscoring the scale of value creation possible in large redevelopment projects. For developers, the project highlights how land-constrained metros continue to unlock major housing and commercial supply through cluster redevelopment. The announcement also reflects the growing attractiveness of large-format urban regeneration, where scale, location and saleable inventory can reshape local real estate economics. In a market increasingly driven by density, infrastructure and premium housing demand, Motilal Nagar stands out as a landmark redevelopment opportunity.

records.title: Hyderabad’s premium housing boom raises affordability fears as ₹2 crore homes multiply
records.description: Hyderabad’s residential market is seeing a sharp shift toward high-rise, premium housing, with developers pushing more luxury inventory in the city’s fast-growing corridors. The surge in homes priced around ₹2 crore and above reflects strong demand from affluent buyers and investors, but it is also widening concerns about affordability for end users. Market watchers say the expansion has been aided by generous floor space index policies and rapid urban growth, yet infrastructure delivery is struggling to keep pace with the pace of construction. Buyers are increasingly asking whether roads, utilities and civic services can support the rising tower density. The trend signals a mature but more expensive market, where premium launches are likely to remain active even as housing accessibility becomes a growing concern.

records.title: Mumbai redevelopment rush pushes developers to bundle appliances and furnishings to win homeowners
records.description: Mumbai’s redevelopment boom is intensifying competition among developers, with many going beyond additional square footage to attract society members and homeowners. In a market where rebuilding old housing stock is often delayed by approvals, relocation costs and negotiation hurdles, builders are now offering incentives such as air conditioners, televisions and other household appliances to sweeten deals. The trend reflects a broader shift in redevelopment strategy: firms are increasingly trying to reduce resistance from residents while differentiating their proposals in crowded micro-markets. For homeowners, these add-ons can improve the immediate appeal of a project, but the core decision still hinges on trust, delivery timelines and the final quality of the rebuilt home. As land supply remains constrained in Mumbai, redevelopment continues to be a key route for new housing generation and value creation.

records.title: Signature Global Joins Tonino Lamborghini for ₹2,890 Crore Branded Housing Project in Gurugram
records.description: Signature Global has teamed up with Italian luxury brand Tonino Lamborghini to develop a premium residential project worth ₹2,890.9 crore in Gurugram’s Sector 71. The collaboration marks another sign of growing demand for branded and high-end housing in the NCR market, where developers are increasingly targeting affluent buyers seeking lifestyle-led homes and stronger value positioning. The project is expected to add a new luxury offering to Gurugram’s residential pipeline, which has seen steady interest from end users and investors alike. With premium housing continuing to outperform in several micro-markets, the deal underlines how international branding is being used to differentiate projects and attract buyers in India’s luxury real estate segment.

records.title: Hyderabad office leasing from Invesco signals sustained demand for large-scale commercial space
records.description: Invesco (India) has leased more than 2.23 lakh sq ft of office space in Hyderabad for five years, at a monthly rent of ₹1.52 crore, according to data accessed by Propstack. The transaction underscores the continued appetite for sizable Grade A commercial assets in major Indian office markets, even as companies fine-tune regional expansion plans. Large-format leasing activity remains a key indicator of confidence in India’s office sector, especially in spaces offering strong connectivity, modern infrastructure and scope for long-term tenancy. Such deals also reinforce Hyderabad’s standing as a prominent commercial hub, supported by a deep talent pool and corporate demand. For landlords and developers, sizable occupier commitments can aid portfolio stability and improve absorption in premium office corridors.

records.title: Invesco Leases Over 2.23 Lakh Sq Ft in Hyderabad Office Deal Worth ₹1.52 Crore Monthly
records.description: Invesco (India) has signed a five-year lease for more than 2.23 lakh sq ft of office space in Hyderabad at a monthly rent of ₹1.52 crore, according to data accessed by Propstack. The transaction reflects continued leasing momentum in India’s commercial real estate market, especially in major IT and business hubs that continue to attract global financial and technology occupiers. Large-format office deals such as this underline the strength of demand for premium workplace space in well-connected urban corridors. With occupiers prioritising scale, efficiency and access to talent, Hyderabad remains one of the key markets benefitting from corporate expansion and long-term leasing commitments in the current cycle.

records.title: Dharavi redevelopment drive pushes Matunga railway land residents to vacate before monsoon
records.description: The Dharavi Redevelopment Project (DRP) Authority has appealed to slum dwellers living on railway land in Mumbai’s Matunga area to vacate their homes ahead of the monsoon, as the site is cleared for redevelopment and rehabilitation work. The move is part of the broader Dharavi transformation programme, which continues to reshape large pockets of urban land into formal housing and infrastructure assets. While the notice is tied to Mumbai, the redevelopment push reflects trends seen across NCR as well, where large-scale urban renewal, land clearance and rehabilitation-linked projects are opening up new investment opportunities. For buyers and developers tracking premium redevelopment activity, the episode highlights how government-backed land interventions can accelerate housing supply and unlock long-term value in high-density urban markets.

records.title: Mumbai redevelopment trend shows why some homeowners are opting out of moving back
records.description: A growing but often overlooked pattern is emerging in Mumbai’s redevelopment market: while many residents return to newly rebuilt towers and larger apartments, a small section of flat owners is choosing not to move back after possession. The reasons are increasingly tied to lifestyle shifts, changing family needs and the economics of redeveloped housing, where a bigger home does not always translate into the right fit for the original owner. The trend also highlights how redevelopment is reshaping housing decisions in dense urban markets, especially in older neighbourhoods where land values are high and new project layouts often differ sharply from the original structures. For developers and housing societies, the shift underscores the need to plan not just for construction and approvals, but also for post-completion occupancy and homeowner retention.

records.title: Brigade Group Signs JDA for 8.63 Acres in East Bengaluru for Mixed-Use Township
records.description: Brigade Group has signed a joint development agreement for an 8.63-acre land parcel in Gunjur, east Bengaluru, to develop a larger mixed-use township spread across about 39 acres. The project adds to the developer’s pipeline in one of the city’s most active residential micro-markets, where infrastructure upgrades and sustained housing demand continue to support new launches. The township is expected to combine residential development with supporting mixed-use elements, positioning it for buyers looking for homes in an area that has seen steady interest from end-users and investors alike. The latest deal also underscores how developers are expanding in Bengaluru’s eastern corridor, where connectivity improvements and land availability remain key triggers for growth. Brigade’s move comes amid broader momentum in residential real estate, with developers targeting well-located urban expansion zones.

records.title: Bengaluru Tenants Push Back as Tiny Flats and Soaring Rents Stretch the Rental Market
records.description: Bengaluru’s rental market is coming under fresh scrutiny as tenants report sharply higher asking rents, shrinking apartment sizes and increasingly strict lease conditions. In several neighbourhoods, even compact 2BHK homes are being marketed at premium rates, with some listings drawing attention for offering just 200 sq ft of space at rents as high as ₹80,000 a month. The backlash highlights a wider mismatch between tenant expectations and landlord pricing in one of India’s hottest housing markets. Beyond cost, renters are also flagging poor-quality construction, cramped layouts and weak living conditions, making the search for suitable homes more difficult. The trend underscores how housing affordability remains a major concern in fast-growing urban micro-markets, even as demand for rental accommodation stays strong.

records.title: Bengaluru Tenants Say Rising Rents Are Making Basic Housing a Luxury
records.description: Tenants in Bengaluru are voicing growing frustration over sharply rising rents and shrinking housing options, with many saying it now feels easier to find a job than an affordable home. Persistent demand in the city’s rental market has pushed up costs, while options that meet basic livability standards such as sunlight, ventilation and reasonable deposits are becoming harder to secure. The complaints reflect a wider strain in major Indian tech hubs, where rental inflation is outpacing household budgets and forcing many residents to compromise on space, location or amenities. The story underscores how tight housing supply and strong urban migration continue to shape the residential market, keeping pressure on renters and raising questions about affordability across India’s fast-growing cities.

records.title: Delhi–Dehradun Expressway Likely to Lift Land, Logistics and Plotted Demand Along NCR Corridor
records.description: The inauguration of the Delhi-Dehradun Expressway by Prime Minister Narendra Modi is expected to reshape real estate activity across its corridor, with land, plotted developments, logistics and warehousing seen as the key beneficiaries. Improved connectivity is likely to strengthen demand in locations linked to the Delhi-NCR belt, especially for buyers and developers looking at long-term appreciation near major transport infrastructure. Property consultants say such large-scale road projects typically open up new investment pockets, improve last-mile access and attract end-user and industrial interest. For homebuyers and investors, the expressway may also influence pricing expectations in adjoining micro-markets, while boosting prospects for mixed-use and support infrastructure development. The broader impact will depend on execution, access points and how quickly surrounding areas absorb fresh demand.

records.title: Delhi–Dehradun Expressway Opens New Growth Corridor for NCR Real Estate
records.description: The inauguration of the Delhi-Dehradun Expressway on April 14 is expected to reshape real estate demand across the corridor by improving travel time and strengthening regional connectivity. The expressway is likely to benefit land, plotted development, logistics and warehousing markets, while also supporting long-term residential interest in connected NCR micro markets. Improved highway access often lifts buyer confidence in peripheral locations, particularly where infrastructure is now catching up with development potential. Industry watchers say the biggest gains may come in areas linked to future mobility, employment hubs and industrial activity, as better connectivity tends to trigger plotted housing demand and slower-but-steady appreciation in land prices. For investors, the route presents an opportunity to track locations with direct access to the new infrastructure push and existing social amenities.

records.title: RMZ Plans $35 Billion Push into Data Centres, AI Infrastructure and Housing Over Five Years
records.description: Real estate firm RMZ Corp has outlined an ambitious investment plan of more than $35 billion over the next five years, targeting data centres, AI factories, mixed-use commercial offices and housing projects. The move reflects how developers are diversifying beyond traditional office and residential assets to capture demand from technology-led infrastructure and premium urban development. RMZ said it is exploring an initial public offering, adding another layer of momentum to its expansion strategy. The company’s latest plans come at a time when Indian real estate is benefiting from sustained interest in commercial assets, digital infrastructure and high-end housing. With data centres and AI-linked facilities emerging as a major growth theme, the investment could strengthen the sector’s long-term pipeline and attract further institutional capital into large-format real estate projects.

records.title: Bengaluru Tenant-Landlord Row Highlights Rising Upfront Costs in Rental Deals
records.description: A Bengaluru rental listing has triggered debate after a tenant was reportedly asked to pay a two-month security deposit along with an additional ₹25,000 deposit for electronic appliances. The unusual condition has drawn attention to how landlords are structuring rentals in major Indian cities, especially in high-demand housing markets where tenants often face sizable upfront costs beyond standard rent and deposit terms. While the listing itself is specific to Bengaluru, the issue reflects a broader urban housing trend: rising rental friction, stricter deposit demands and greater scrutiny of what is included in a leased home. For home seekers and investors, the episode underscores the need for clearer rental agreements, transparent appliance ownership terms and better documentation in increasingly competitive residential markets.

records.title: Landlord Insurance Usually Won’t Protect a Tenant’s Belongings, Experts Warn
records.description: Tenants should not assume a landlord’s property insurance will cover their personal items in the event of damage from incidents such as floods, earthquakes or other property-related losses. While the building structure and fixed assets are generally protected under the owner’s policy, furniture, electronics, clothing and other contents owned by the tenant typically remain the tenant’s responsibility. The guidance is especially relevant for renters in high-density urban markets such as Gurugram, where apartment living is common and households often keep expensive appliances and personal valuables indoors. Real estate advisers say renters should check policy terms carefully and consider separate contents insurance if they want financial protection for their belongings. The reminder comes as rental housing demand stays strong and tenants increasingly look for clarity on risk-sharing before signing lease agreements.

records.title: HT Real Estate Guide: Landlord insurance often excludes tenants’ personal belongings
records.description: Tenants should not assume that a landlord’s property insurance will automatically protect their own possessions. In most rental arrangements, the owner’s policy typically covers structural damage to the building caused by events such as floods, earthquakes or fire, but it does not extend to a tenant’s furniture, electronics, clothing or other personal items. That means renters remain responsible for insuring their own contents if they want financial protection against theft, accidental damage or natural disasters. The issue is especially relevant in urban rental markets where homes are leased unfurnished or semi-furnished and personal investment in household goods can be significant. For tenants in high-rent markets, content insurance can help reduce out-of-pocket losses and provide a clearer understanding of what is, and is not, covered under a rental agreement.

records.title: Noida’s Airport-Led Boom Puts Pressure on Gurugram’s NCR Real Estate Dominance
records.description: Noida’s real estate market is emerging as a stronger contender in the NCR, powered by the inauguration of the Noida International Airport, expanding metro links and fresh road infrastructure. These connectivity upgrades are improving accessibility across key micro-markets and strengthening demand from both end-users and investors. Developers and buyers are increasingly viewing Noida as a long-term growth corridor, especially as infrastructure-led appreciation continues to attract attention in comparison with established Gurugram locations. While Gurugram still holds an edge in premium housing, commercial hubs and corporate demand, Noida’s improving physical infrastructure is narrowing the gap. The city’s momentum is also being supported by broader market confidence across NCR, making it one of the region’s most closely watched real estate destinations for 2026.

records.title: Apartment Buyers Urged to Look Beyond Price as Lifetime Maintenance Costs Add Up
records.description: Homebuyers considering an apartment purchase are being advised to calculate the full cost of ownership instead of focusing only on the headline price. Besides the sale value, recurring expenses such as maintenance charges, property taxes, GST, repairs, insurance, and long-term upkeep can materially change the affordability of a home over time. The guide highlights that these costs often rise as buildings age, making a seemingly budget-friendly apartment significantly more expensive over the years. For buyers in fast-growing NCR markets, especially in premium and urban residential zones, factoring in operational costs is essential before committing to a purchase. The piece positions lifetime maintenance planning as a key part of smarter property decision-making in 2026.

records.title: Shreya Ghoshal Buys Two Luxury Flats in Mumbai’s Worli for Nearly ₹60 Crore
records.description: Singer Shreya Ghoshal, along with her parents Shamishtha Ghoshal and Biswajit Ghoshal, has expanded her property portfolio with the purchase of two luxury apartments in Mumbai’s Worli for nearly ₹60 crore. The deal underlines continued appetite for ultra-premium residential assets in South and central Mumbai, where demand remains supported by limited supply, strong capital values and the appeal of sea-facing and high-rise developments. Worli has emerged as one of the city’s most sought-after luxury micro-markets, drawing both end users and investors seeking marquee addresses. The transaction adds to a growing list of high-value home purchases by celebrities and business leaders, reflecting resilience in India’s top-end housing market despite broader affordability pressures elsewhere.

records.title: Apartment buyers urged to account for lifetime maintenance costs amid rising ownership burden
records.description: Homebuyers evaluating apartments are being advised to look beyond the headline purchase price and calculate the full cost of ownership over time. In addition to the base price, buyers must factor in maintenance charges, property taxes, GST where applicable, and long-term upkeep expenses that can materially change affordability. The guidance is especially relevant in high-cost urban housing markets, where monthly outgoes for society maintenance, repairs and periodic replacements can add up significantly over the years. A realistic budget should also include sinking funds, premium services and potential increases in resident welfare charges. For buyers, this broader approach can help avoid financial stress after possession and improve comparisons between ready homes and under-construction projects. Industry experts say understanding lifetime costs is now as important as negotiating the initial deal.

records.title: Hyderabad Home Sales Rise Marginally in Q1 2026 as Prices Jump 9%
records.description: Hyderabad’s residential market posted a modest uptick in activity in the first quarter of 2026, with home sales rising 1% year-on-year to 9,541 units, according to market data. The stronger trend was on the pricing side, where average residential rates climbed 9% to ₹8,211 per sq ft, reflecting continued demand resilience in the city’s housing market. The numbers suggest that while buyer volumes are stabilising, developers are still able to command higher prices, likely supported by healthy end-user demand and ongoing interest in established growth corridors. The latest quarter also underscores Hyderabad’s position as one of India’s more active real estate markets, with price appreciation continuing even as transaction growth remains measured. For investors and homebuyers, the combination of steady sales and rising values points to sustained confidence in the city’s housing outlook.

records.title: Bengaluru GBA’s 15% Deviation Proposal Triggers Debate Over Relief and Rule Violations
records.description: Bengaluru’s Greater Bengaluru Authority (GBA) has proposed amending the city’s building bye-laws to increase the permissible construction deviation limit from 5% to 15%, a move that has sparked debate among homeowners, developers and planners. Supporters say the change could ease hardship for property owners facing minor design or measurement variances in completed homes. Critics, however, warn that a wider tolerance may dilute compliance standards and indirectly regularise construction violations. As NCR cities continue to see steady residential and commercial activity, the Bengaluru discussion adds to a broader national conversation on how regulators balance enforcement with practical relief. The proposal also comes at a time when India’s real estate sector is closely watching policy changes, infrastructure-led growth and housing affordability trends across major urban markets.

records.title: GBA proposal to raise building deviation limit to 15% sparks relief and rule-bending concerns
records.description: Bengaluru’s Greater Bengaluru Authority has proposed amending building bye-laws to raise the permissible construction deviation limit from 5% to 15%, a move that could have wider implications for compliance, redevelopment and homeowner relief. The proposal is being viewed as potentially easing hardship for property owners who face penalties for minor variations from sanctioned plans. At the same time, it has also triggered debate over whether a higher tolerance band could effectively legitimise violations and weaken planning discipline. The change comes amid a busy real estate environment in key Indian cities, where developers and homebuyers are closely watching regulatory shifts, infrastructure upgrades and policy decisions that may influence project approvals, delivery timelines and market sentiment. If adopted, the revision could affect how housing societies, individual owners and builders approach construction oversight.

records.title: Delhi-NCR Real Estate Outlook Sharpens as Policy Support, Infra Push and Affordable Housing Remain in Focus
records.description: Real estate activity across the NCR continues to be shaped by policy stability, infrastructure expansion and end-user demand, with Gurugram and nearby markets drawing the biggest share of attention from developers and investors. Recent market trends point to steady appetite for premium housing, redevelopment opportunities and improved connectivity-led demand around metro-linked corridors. At the same time, regulatory moves and clearer housing rules are expected to support buyer confidence, particularly in projects where compliance and delivery timelines matter most. Industry watchers say continued policy support, along with urban infrastructure upgrades, could keep residential and commercial real estate sentiment resilient. For investors, the focus remains on well-connected micro-markets, projects with strong execution visibility and locations that benefit from upcoming transport and civic improvements.

records.title: Mumbai real estate stays in focus as luxury deals, policy moves and office demand shape market outlook
records.description: India’s property market continued to see activity across premium housing, office leasing and policy developments, with buyers and developers responding to steady demand in key urban micro-markets. Luxury residential transactions remained a highlight, underscoring strong appetite for high-value homes among affluent buyers, even as broader residential sales have shown signs of moderation in some cities. On the policy front, a stable interest-rate environment is expected to support home loan affordability and provide developers with greater planning certainty. Infrastructure upgrades, redevelopment projects and growing office absorption are also reinforcing long-term investment prospects. For NCR buyers and investors, these trends point to continued opportunities in both end-user housing and commercial real estate, especially in well-connected corridors benefiting from transit-led growth and urban expansion.

For investors and end-users alike, the market message is clear: pricing alone no longer tells the full story in India’s housing sector.

records.title: रोम में मोदी-मेलोनी वार्ता से भारत-इटली साझेदारी मजबूत, टेक और बुनियादी ढांचे में निवेश के नए संकेत
records.description: प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी की इटली यात्रा के दौरान भारत और इटली ने अपनी विशेष रणनीतिक साझेदारी को नए स्तर पर ले जाने का संकेत दिया है। दोनों देशों के बीच एआई, क्वांटम, स्पेस और टेक्नोलॉजी जैसे उभरते क्षेत्रों में सहयोग बढ़ाने पर सहमति बनी है, साथ ही इंडिया-इटली इनोवेशन सेंटर स्थापित करने की योजना भी सामने आई है। हालांकि यह खबर सीधे रियल एस्टेट से जुड़ी नहीं है, लेकिन ऐसे अंतरराष्ट्रीय आर्थिक और तकनीकी समझौते NCR जैसे बाजारों में अप्रत्यक्ष रूप से पूंजी प्रवाह, कॉर्पोरेट विस्तार और कमर्शियल स्पेस की मांग को प्रभावित कर सकते हैं। गुरुग्राम में वैश्विक कंपनियों की मौजूदगी को देखते हुए यह साझेदारी ऑफिस, आईटी पार्क और हाई-एंड हाउसिंग सेगमेंट के लिए सकारात्मक संकेत मानी जा सकती है।

records.title: इटली-भारत साझेदारी से रियल एस्टेट और इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर निवेश के नए मौके, AI-टेक सहयोग पर जोर
records.description: भारत और इटली के बीच विशेष रणनीतिक साझेदारी की घोषणा के बाद रियल एस्टेट और इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर सेक्टर में नए निवेश संकेत उभरे हैं। पीएम मोदी और इतालवी प्रधानमंत्री जॉर्जिया मेलोनी की मुलाकात में AI, क्वांटम, स्पेस और टेक्नोलॉजी सहयोग बढ़ाने पर सहमति बनी, जिससे औद्योगिक पार्क, इनोवेशन हब और हाई-टेक कमर्शियल स्पेस की मांग को समर्थन मिल सकता है। साथ ही इंडिया-इटली इनोवेशन सेंटर की स्थापना का निर्णय दीर्घकालिक कारोबारी गतिविधियों को बढ़ावा दे सकता है। विशेषज्ञों के मुताबिक ऐसी साझेदारियां टियर-1 शहरों में ऑफिस स्पेस, एसईजेड-आधारित विकास और वैश्विक कंपनियों के लिए विस्तार योजनाओं को गति देती हैं। NCR में यह रुझान विशेष रूप से गुरुग्राम जैसे प्रीमियम कमर्शियल बाजार के लिए सकारात्मक माना जा रहा है।

records.title: India’s Real Estate Market Gains Momentum as Investment, AI Adoption and Yield Outlook Strengthen
records.description: India’s real estate sector is drawing renewed attention as fresh industry reports point to stronger investment flows, rising technology adoption and a buoyant long-term growth outlook. The market is being supported by domestic capital, which is increasingly driving transactions across residential, commercial and mixed-use segments. Analysts say the sector’s expansion is also being shaped by better project execution, greater transparency and wider use of AI tools in planning, sales and asset management. With India positioned as one of Asia-Pacific’s high-yield real estate markets, developers and investors are eyeing opportunities in premium housing, office assets and emerging urban corridors. The broader outlook suggests that real estate will remain a major engine of growth through 2047, backed by rising demand and structural shifts in the property market.

records.title: ताइवान से लेकर चीन तक एशिया में छिड़ा तनाव, क्षेत्रीय निवेश और रियल एस्टेट सेंटिमेंट पर असर

records.description: मध्य-पूर्व में होर्मुज जलडमरूमध्य के आसपास बढ़ते तनाव और चीन-ईरान-यूएस टकराव ने वैश्विक तेल आपूर्ति, शिपिंग लागत और मुद्रास्फीति के जोखिम को फिर सुर्खियों में ला दिया है। ऐसे माहौल में रियल एस्टेट बाजार, खासकर एनसीआर के प्रीमियम और कमर्शियल सेगमेंट, पर भी अप्रत्यक्ष दबाव देखने को मिल सकता है। ऊंची इनपुट कॉस्ट, फाइनेंसिंग पर असर और अंतरराष्ट्रीय अस्थिरता निवेशकों की धारणा को प्रभावित करते हैं। दूसरी ओर, सुरक्षित और बेहतर कनेक्टिविटी वाले माइक्रो-मार्केट्स में लंबी अवधि के लिए निवेश की मांग बनी रह सकती है। गुरुग्राम जैसे कॉर्पोरेट हब में ऑफिस और लग्जरी प्रोजेक्ट्स को लेकर रुझान टिकाऊ रहने की संभावना है, जबकि किफायती आवास और इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर-लिंक्ड क्षेत्रों में भी मौके बने रह सकते हैं।

records.title: NCR रियल एस्टेट में नए निवेश संकेत, गुरुग्राम के प्रीमियम और कमर्शियल सेगमेंट पर नजर
records.description: दिल्ली-एनसीआर के रियल एस्टेट बाजार में प्रीमियम और कमर्शियल प्रॉपर्टी की मांग लगातार चर्चा में बनी हुई है। क्षेत्र में बेहतर कनेक्टिविटी, हाई-एंड ऑफिस स्पेस, लग्जरी हाउसिंग और नए इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर प्रोजेक्ट्स ने निवेशकों की दिलचस्पी को बढ़ाया है। खासकर गुरुग्राम जैसे मार्केट में मल्टीनेशनल कंपनियों की मौजूदगी, एक्सप्रेसवे नेटवर्क और तेजी से विकसित होते व्यवसायिक कॉरिडोर इसे रियल एस्टेट निवेश के लिए मजबूत विकल्प बना रहे हैं। विशेषज्ञों का मानना है कि आने वाले महीनों में अच्छी लोकेशन वाले प्रोजेक्ट्स, ग्रेड-ए ऑफिस स्पेस और मिश्रित उपयोग वाली संपत्तियों में मांग बनी रह सकती है। खरीददार अब केवल कीमत नहीं, बल्कि लोकेशन, रिटर्न और दीर्घकालिक वैल्यू को प्राथमिकता दे रहे हैं।

records.title: वियतनाम-भारत कूटनीति से बढ़ी रियल एस्टेट और इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर निवेश की उम्मीदें
records.description: वियतनामी राष्ट्रपति टो लाम की भारत यात्रा के बीच व्यापार, कनेक्टिविटी और औद्योगिक सहयोग पर चर्चा ने निवेशकों का ध्यान NCR की ओर खींचा है। ऐसे दौर में गुरुग्राम और फरीदाबाद जैसे बाजारों में कॉर्पोरेट स्पेस, लॉजिस्टिक्स पार्क, मैन्युफैक्चरिंग क्लस्टर और आवासीय परियोजनाओं को नई गति मिलने की संभावना है। गुरुग्राम पहले से ही प्रीमियम ऑफिस और लग्जरी हाउसिंग के लिए मजबूत केंद्र बना हुआ है, जबकि फरीदाबाद में बेहतर सड़क संपर्क, औद्योगिक आधार और अपेक्षाकृत किफायती कीमतों के कारण मिड-सेगमेंट आवास और वेयरहाउसिंग मांग बढ़ सकती है। क्षेत्रीय सहयोग, सप्लाई-चेन विस्तार और इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर अपग्रेड से दोनों शहरों में जमीन, किराये और डेवलपमेंट प्रोजेक्ट्स पर सकारात्मक असर दिख सकता है।

records.title: गुरुग्राम में कड़ी निगरानी के साथ प्रॉपर्टी बाजार पर फोकस, NCR में निवेश पर नई नजर
records.description: NCR के रियल एस्टेट बाजार में निवेशकों की दिलचस्पी एक बार फिर मजबूत बनी हुई है, खासकर गुरुग्राम जैसे कॉरपोरेट और लग्जरी हब में। शहर में प्रीमियम हाउसिंग, वाणिज्यिक परियोजनाओं और इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर अपग्रेड की वजह से मांग को सपोर्ट मिल रहा है। बेहतर कनेक्टिविटी, नए ट्रांसपोर्ट कॉरिडोर और ऑफिस स्पेस की बढ़ती जरूरत ने प्रॉपर्टी वैल्यू को सहारा दिया है। डेवलपर्स भी हाई-एंड और मिड-सेगमेंट दोनों श्रेणियों में नई पेशकश बढ़ा रहे हैं। विशेषज्ञों के मुताबिक, चुनिंदा माइक्रो-मार्केट्स में किराये की आय और पूंजीगत वृद्धि की संभावनाएं बनी हुई हैं। हालांकि, खरीदारों के लिए परियोजना की लोकेशन, डिलीवरी टाइमलाइन और डेवलपर ट्रैक रिकॉर्ड की जांच जरूरी है।

records.title: Omaxe Group secures ₹75 crore from WSB Partners to fund Tier II expansion
records.description: Omaxe Group has raised ₹75 crore from WSB Partners, marking a fresh funding push for its real estate expansion in Tier II markets. The capital infusion is expected to support the developer’s project pipeline and strengthen execution across emerging urban centres, where housing demand has remained resilient. With developers increasingly looking beyond metro markets for growth, Tier II cities are drawing greater investor attention due to improving infrastructure, better connectivity and relatively lower entry prices. The deal also underscores continued private capital interest in India’s residential real estate segment, particularly in growth corridors outside the top-tier cities. For buyers and investors, the move signals that smaller urban markets may continue to gain traction as developers deploy fresh capital into new launches and project delivery.

records.title: Omaxe Group secures ₹75 crore from WSB Partners to accelerate Tier II real estate projects
records.description: Omaxe Group has secured ₹75 crore in funding from WSB Partners to support the development of its Tier II real estate portfolio, underscoring continued investor interest in emerging urban markets. The capital infusion is expected to help the developer advance its next phase of projects beyond major metros, where demand for organised housing and mixed-use spaces is rising steadily. Tier II cities are increasingly drawing attention from developers and private equity players as infrastructure improves, migration expands, and affordability becomes a key demand driver. For Omaxe, the funding adds momentum at a time when developers are looking to diversify growth away from saturated markets and tap into newer centres with long-term residential and commercial potential.

records.title: Wipro Founder Azim Premji’s Son Buys Luxury Bengaluru Penthouse for ₹45.71 Crore
records.description: Tariq Premji, son of Wipro founder Azim Premji, has purchased a luxury duplex penthouse in Bengaluru for ₹45.71 crore, according to property registration documents. The transaction adds to the city’s premium housing momentum, where demand for high-value homes remains supported by limited supply in select micro-markets and a steady appetite from wealthy buyers. Bengaluru’s luxury real estate segment continues to attract attention from business families and senior professionals seeking large-format residences with privacy, amenities and strong long-term value. The deal also underscores how end-user demand and wealth-driven purchases are sustaining the upper end of India’s housing market even amid broader uncertainty in the economy and global markets.

records.title: Gurugram’s Growth Story Gains New Momentum as Key Infrastructure Corridors Drive Realty Demand
records.description: Gurugram’s real estate market is being reshaped by infrastructure-led growth, with major corridors such as the Dwarka Expressway and Southern Peripheral Road emerging as the strongest demand drivers. Improved connectivity, faster access to Delhi and the airport, and large-scale civic upgrades are attracting both end-users and investors to the city’s premium and high-growth micro-markets. Developers are increasingly launching projects around these transport nodes, betting on sustained buyer interest in areas with long-term appreciation potential. The city’s evolving real estate landscape also reflects a broader shift toward integrated living, where buyers are prioritising convenience, amenities and location quality over traditional price-led decisions. As corridors continue to unlock new pockets of development, Gurugram remains one of NCR’s most closely watched property markets.

records.title: भारत-नॉर्वे साझेदारी से रियल एस्टेट और इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर निवेश के नए मौके खुलने की उम्मीद
records.description: भारत और नॉर्वे के बीच बढ़ती रणनीतिक साझेदारी का असर रियल एस्टेट और इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर सेक्टर पर भी देखने को मिल सकता है। हालिया वार्ताओं में ग्रीन एनर्जी, ब्लू इकोनॉमी, टेक्नोलॉजी और निवेश सहयोग पर हुए समझौतों से NCR जैसे बड़े बाजारों में विदेशी पूंजी के लिए माहौल और मजबूत होने की संभावना है। विशेषज्ञों के मुताबिक, ऐसी अंतरराष्ट्रीय भागीदारी से लॉजिस्टिक्स, ऑफिस स्पेस, वेयरहाउसिंग और टिकाऊ आवास परियोजनाओं में निवेश की गति बढ़ सकती है। हरित विकास और तकनीक-आधारित परियोजनाओं पर जोर दिल्ली-एनसीआर के रियल एस्टेट बाजार को भी लंबी अवधि में सहारा दे सकता है। खासकर गुरुग्राम जैसे कॉर्पोरेट हब और आसपास के तेज़ी से विकसित हो रहे शहरी क्षेत्रों को इसका लाभ मिल सकता है।

records.title: Bengaluru tenant contests 33% rent hike demand after lease expiry, as housing costs rise
records.description: A Bengaluru tenant in the Jakkur-Yelahanka corridor has triggered a wider debate on rent escalation after the landlord sought a 33% increase once the lease period ended, despite the rental agreement permitting only a 5% hike. The case underscores how sharply residential rents are climbing in India’s major urban housing markets, particularly in tech-driven neighbourhoods where demand remains strong and supply is tightening. Tenants are increasingly questioning whether post-lease rent revisions should stay within agreed contractual limits or reflect broader inflationary pressures. The dispute also highlights growing uncertainty for salaried renters as housing affordability comes under pressure in premium NCR-style and Bengaluru micro-markets. For both landlords and tenants, the matter points to the need for clearer lease terms, predictable escalation clauses and stronger awareness of rental rights.

records.title: Bengaluru, Navi Mumbai, Gurugram and Other Markets Dominate Outlook Money’s Latest Real Estate Coverage
records.description: Outlook Money’s real estate section is tracking a wave of market-moving developments across India’s property sector, with a strong emphasis on infrastructure-led growth, regulatory action and shifting buyer preferences. Recent stories highlight how digital property systems, online mutation reforms, and e-complaint mechanisms are helping improve transparency and streamline ownership processes. On the demand side, reports point to rising residential interest in transit-linked corridors, premium housing clusters and emerging micro-markets, while rental rates and developer activity continue to reflect a firm urban housing cycle. The coverage also shows how avenues such as auctions, housing schemes, and townships are shaping investment opportunities for end-users and investors alike. Overall, the latest updates suggest that real estate remains supported by infrastructure expansion, compliance reforms and changing lifestyle demand.

records.title: Delhi-NCR Real Estate Listing Spotlights Surge in Luxury, Green and Transit-Led Housing Demand
records.description: Outlook Money’s real estate listing highlights the sharp shift in India’s housing market toward premium, future-ready homes, with buyers increasingly prioritising lifestyle, connectivity and long-term value over basic entry-level purchases. The latest crop of articles points to strong momentum across Delhi-NCR, where luxury demand, infrastructure-linked growth and sustainable housing are reshaping buyer preferences. Gurugram continues to stand out as a key market, driven by major investment inflows, expressway-led expansion and rising interest in high-end residential projects. The listing also reflects growing traction for green real estate and integrated townships, underscoring how developers are responding to changing consumer expectations. For investors and end-users alike, the current market cycle favours location with strong infrastructure, quality construction and amenities that support future appreciation.

records.title: Hyderabad, Jaipur and Mumbai Drive India’s Luxury Housing Momentum as Green Buildings Gain Ground
records.description: India’s real estate market is showing a clear shift toward premium housing, greener developments and stronger regional demand. Recent reporting highlights Hyderabad’s emergence as a luxury housing hub, Jaipur’s transition from a tourist city into an upscale property destination, and continued resilience in Mumbai’s residential market. Developers are increasingly targeting affluent buyers with larger homes, branded projects and amenity-rich communities, while sustainability is becoming a stronger selling point. Green buildings are attracting attention for their lower operating costs and better tenant retention, especially in cities competing for global capital. At the same time, regulatory actions and housing scheme updates continue to shape buyer sentiment, reinforcing a market that is becoming more selective but remains active across key urban centres.

records.title: India’s Realty Spotlight Shifts to Infrastructure-Led Growth, Premium Demand and Investor Interest
records.description: Outlook Money’s latest real estate coverage points to a market being shaped by infrastructure upgrades, stable buyer sentiment and selective price momentum across key NCR-linked corridors. Recent reports highlight how airport-led development, expressway connectivity and policy support are influencing housing demand, while premium and luxury segments continue to draw investor attention. At the same time, affordable housing and plotted development remain important in emerging urban pockets, especially where road networks and civic upgrades are improving liveability. The broader trend suggests that Indian real estate is moving beyond headline sales velocity toward stronger absorption, better product segmentation and location-driven value creation. For buyers and investors, the focus is increasingly on projects backed by connectivity, pricing resilience and long-term end-use potential rather than speculative appreciation.

records.title: NCR Real Estate Momentum Builds as Infrastructure, Mid-Segment Demand and Luxury Sales Stay Resilient
records.description: NCR’s real estate market continues to show strong momentum, supported by infrastructure upgrades, improving buyer sentiment and steady demand across premium and mid-segment housing. A series of recent developments in and around Gurugram point to sustained interest from end-users and investors alike, with luxury housing maintaining its lead in the region. Market updates also indicate that infrastructure-linked corridors and better connectivity are reshaping price expectations and driving fresh launches. While some pockets are seeing sharper appreciation, the broader trend suggests a market that is becoming more selective, with buyers prioritising location, access and quality over speculation. For investors, NCR remains one of the country’s most closely watched real estate markets, especially as capital values and rental demand continue to reflect long-term confidence in the region’s growth story.

records.title: India’s real estate heat map shifts as NCR-led demand, infra upgrades and policy support reshape investor sentiment
records.description: India’s real estate market is being reshaped by a mix of infrastructure expansion, stronger buyer confidence and a widening focus beyond metro cores. Recent coverage of Outlook Money’s real estate segment highlights how corridor-led development, airport-linked growth, premium housing demand and regulatory changes are influencing both end-users and investors. In NCR, the Delhi-Dehradun Expressway, Jewar airport developments and rising luxury and mid-segment activity are reinforcing the region’s appeal, while housing demand remains sensitive to interest-rate direction and supply trends. At the same time, tier-II and tier-III markets are gaining traction as affordability pressures push buyers toward emerging corridors. The overall market picture points to a more selective but resilient cycle, with capital chasing locations backed by infrastructure, absorption and long-term livability.

records.title: Delhi–Dehradun Expressway Emerges as a Realty Catalyst for North India
records.description: The Delhi–Dehradun Expressway is rapidly shaping up as a major growth driver for North India’s property market, with land values and housing demand expected to strengthen along the corridor. The expressway is improving connectivity between Delhi-NCR and key locations in Uttarakhand, opening up fresh opportunities for plotted developments, early-stage residential projects and gateway destinations near transit hubs. Market watchers say the next three to five years could bring a meaningful shift in the region’s real estate map as infrastructure-led demand replaces earlier speculation-driven buying. Investors are increasingly looking at corridor-linked locations for capital appreciation, while developers are expected to launch more projects around improved access points. The broader trend also reflects a more measured market, with buyers focusing on livability, connectivity and long-term value.

records.title: Delhi-Dehradun Expressway Set to Reshape NCR Realty, With Prices Seen Rising 15–25%
records.description: The Delhi-Dehradun Expressway is emerging as a major catalyst for real estate activity across the NCR, with analysts expecting property prices in key pockets along the corridor to climb 15–25% over the next three to five years. Improved connectivity, faster travel times and stronger infrastructure visibility are already drawing attention from both end-users and investors. The expressway is likely to spur plotted developments, early-stage residential projects and fresh demand in emerging micro-markets, especially in areas tied to the broader Delhi-NCR growth belt. Market watchers say the corridor could also change land-use patterns by encouraging township-led development and widening the investment appeal of locations once considered peripheral. As infrastructure-led buying gains momentum, the region is expected to see a shift from speculation to more measured, long-term investment decisions.

records.title: Delhi-NCR real estate pivots toward yield, luxury and transit-led growth
records.description: Delhi-NCR’s property market is showing a clear shift in investor preference, with new buying patterns increasingly tied to rental yield, capital appreciation and infrastructure-led growth. Recent coverage points to strong traction in luxury housing, especially across the NCR belt, even as mid-segment demand and regulated plotted development continue to shape broader market activity. Improved consumer sentiment, a pause in interest-rate hikes and upcoming infrastructure projects such as airport-linked corridors are reinforcing demand in key pockets. At the same time, developers and buyers are weighing absorption quality more closely than headline sales. The region remains one of the most active real estate markets in the country, with both end-users and investors focusing on location, connectivity and long-term value creation.

records.title: Signature Global to deploy ₹3,500 crore on land acquisition and construction as NCR housing demand stays firm
records.description: Signature Global plans to invest about ₹3,500 crore this fiscal year on land buying and construction, signalling continued confidence in the Gurugram housing market. The developer is targeting growth through new project launches and a stronger land pipeline at a time when demand for premium and mid-income homes in NCR remains resilient. The company’s capex strategy reflects a broader trend among listed realty firms to secure inventory early, especially in micro-markets with improving infrastructure and steady absorption. Rising construction activity, along with expectations of continued buyer interest in Gurugram’s residential corridors, is likely to support future sales momentum. For homebuyers and investors, the plan underscores how developers are positioning for the next cycle of growth in the region.

records.title: पश्चिम एशिया तनाव के बीच भारत-इजरायल-यूएई गठजोड़ से रियल एस्टेट और इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर निवेश की नई राह
records.description: पश्चिम एशिया में जारी भू-राजनीतिक तनाव के बीच भारत, इजरायल और यूएई के बीच बढ़ती रणनीतिक नजदीकी का असर अब निवेश और इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर सेक्टर पर भी दिखने लगा है। मजबूत होते ऊर्जा, लॉजिस्टिक्स और व्यापारिक रिश्ते भारतीय बाजार के लिए दीर्घकालिक भरोसा बढ़ा रहे हैं। विशेषज्ञों के मुताबिक, ऐसी साझेदारियां खासतौर पर प्रीमियम कमर्शियल प्रोजेक्ट्स, वेयरहाउसिंग, मिक्स्ड-यूज डेवलपमेंट और औद्योगिक कॉरिडोर में निवेश को गति दे सकती हैं। दिल्ली-एनसीआर जैसे क्षेत्रों में ग्लोबल कैपिटल का रुझान पहले से मजबूत है और राजनीतिक स्थिरता के साथ यह मांग और बढ़ सकती है। बेहतर कनेक्टिविटी, सप्लाई चेन विस्तार और विदेशी निवेश की संभावनाएं रियल एस्टेट बाजार के लिए सकारात्मक संकेत हैं।

records.title: MahaRERA Says Brokerage Refund Claim After Flat Booking Cancellation May Not Stand Under RERA
records.description: MahaRERA has indicated that homebuyers may not be legally entitled to recover brokerage paid at the time of booking if they later cancel a flat purchase, according to a recent complaint it heard under the Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016. The authority’s view suggests that brokerage is not automatically treated as a refundable component unless the dispute is directly covered by the sale agreement or another enforceable term. The clarification is important for homebuyers in NCR’s high-value housing market, where brokerage charges can add a meaningful cost to apartment purchases. For buyers, the ruling underscores the need to review booking documents carefully, especially clauses on cancellation, non-refundable charges and intermediary fees, before committing to a transaction. It also reinforces the broader rule that contractual terms and written disclosures remain central in real estate disputes.

records.title: दिल्ली-NCR में घरों की कीमतें तेज़ी से बढ़ीं, निवेशकों की नज़र अब गुरुग्राम के प्रीमियम प्रोजेक्ट्स पर
records.description: दिल्ली-NCR के रियल एस्टेट बाजार में कीमतों में तेज़ी से बढ़ोतरी देखी जा रही है, जिससे खरीदारों और निवेशकों दोनों की रणनीति बदल रही है। हालिया बाजार रुझानों के मुताबिक, क्षेत्र में अपार्टमेंट्स की कीमतें करीब 20% तक महंगी हुई हैं, जबकि बेहतर कनेक्टिविटी, नए एक्सप्रेसवे, मेट्रो विस्तार और कॉर्पोरेट हब्स ने मांग को और मजबूत किया है। प्रीमियम और कमर्शियल सेगमेंट में गुरुग्राम सबसे आकर्षक विकल्प बनकर उभरा है, जहां बड़े डेवलपर्स लगातार नए प्रोजेक्ट ला रहे हैं। विशेषज्ञों का मानना है कि इन्फ्रास्ट्रक्चर अपग्रेड और नौकरी के अवसरों के चलते आने वाले महीनों में भी इस बाजार में मजबूती बनी रह सकती है।

records.title: दिल्ली-NCR में घर महंगे: एक्सप्रेसवे कनेक्टिविटी और सीमित सप्लाई से रियल एस्टेट बाजार फिर गर्म
records.description: दिल्ली-NCR के रियल एस्टेट बाजार में घरों की कीमतें तेजी से बढ़ रही हैं और इसका सबसे बड़ा कारण बेहतर कनेक्टिविटी, नई सड़क परियोजनाएं और घटती उपलब्ध सप्लाई मानी जा रही है। क्षेत्र में कई बड़े एक्सप्रेसवे और लिंक रोड प्रोजेक्ट्स के चलते गुरुग्राम और आसपास के प्रीमियम हाउसिंग माइक्रो-मार्केट्स में मांग तेज हुई है। डेवलपर्स के मुताबिक, लगातार इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर अपग्रेड, कॉर्पोरेट हब के विस्तार और निवेशकों की बढ़ती दिलचस्पी ने प्रॉपर्टी प्राइस को ऊपर धकेला है। रिपोर्टों के अनुसार, कुछ इलाकों में फ्लैटों की कीमतें 20% तक बढ़ चुकी हैं। ऐसे में खरीदारों के लिए यह बाजार अब केवल आवासीय जरूरत नहीं, बल्कि कैपिटल एप्रिसिएशन वाले निवेश अवसर के रूप में भी देखा जा रहा है।

records.title: दिल्ली-NCR में घरों की कीमतों पर नया दबाव, निवेशकों की नजर गुरुग्राम के प्रीमियम प्रोजेक्ट्स पर
records.description: दिल्ली-NCR में रियल एस्टेट बाजार एक बार फिर तेज़ी के दौर में दिख रहा है। उपलब्ध कंटेंट में प्रॉपर्टी सेक्शन के तहत यह संकेत मिलता है कि खासकर गुरुग्राम जैसे प्रीमियम माइक्रो-मार्केट्स में मांग मजबूत बनी हुई है। कॉरपोरेट हब, बेहतर कनेक्टिविटी, नए इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर लिंक और हाई-एंड हाउसिंग प्रोजेक्ट्स की वजह से यहां निवेशकों की दिलचस्पी बढ़ रही है। विशेषज्ञों के मुताबिक, दिल्ली-NCR में घरों की कीमतों में तेजी का बड़ा कारण सीमित आपूर्ति और बढ़ती खरीद रुचि है। ऐसे में गुरुग्राम में लग्जरी और कमर्शियल दोनों तरह की संपत्तियों को लेकर बाजार का रुख सकारात्मक बना हुआ है। प्रीमियम लोकेशंस में लंबी अवधि के निवेशक अभी बेहतर अवसर तलाश रहे हैं।

records.title: दिल्ली-NCR के पास जमीन और घरों की मांग तेज, निवेशकों की नजर गुरुग्राम-फरीदाबाद कॉरिडोर पर
records.description: दिल्ली-NCR में रियल एस्टेट की रफ्तार लगातार बनी हुई है, और गुरुग्राम-फरीदाबाद बेल्ट में निवेशकों की दिलचस्पी और मजबूत होती दिख रही है। एक्सप्रेसवे, बेहतर कनेक्टिविटी और नए इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर प्रोजेक्ट्स के कारण यह इलाका आवासीय और वाणिज्यिक दोनों तरह की खरीद के लिए आकर्षक बनता जा रहा है। गुरुग्राम में प्रीमियम हाउसिंग, ऑफिस स्पेस और लग्जरी प्रोजेक्ट्स की मांग बनी हुई है, जबकि फरीदाबाद में किफायती घर, प्लॉट और विकासशील सेक्टरों में निवेश के मौके बढ़ रहे हैं। बाजार जानकारों का कहना है कि आने वाले महीनों में कनेक्टिविटी सुधरने और शहरी विस्तार के साथ इन दोनों शहरों में प्रॉपर्टी वैल्यू और बढ़ सकती है।

records.title: गंगा एक्सप्रेसवे के असर से NCR के इन रियल एस्टेट हॉटस्पॉट्स में निवेश की रफ्तार तेज
records.description: दिल्ली-NCR में एक्सप्रेसवे कनेक्टिविटी, मेट्रो विस्तार और तेज़ी से विकसित हो रहे अर्बन कॉरिडोर रियल एस्टेट बाजार को नया आकार दे रहे हैं। खासकर गुरुग्राम और फरीदाबाद से जुड़े इलाकों में निवेशकों की दिलचस्पी लगातार बढ़ रही है। गंगा एक्सप्रेसवे जैसे बड़े इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर प्रोजेक्ट्स का असर आसपास के प्रॉपर्टी बाजार पर भी दिखने लगा है, जहां बेहतर कनेक्टिविटी के चलते जमीन और आवासीय परियोजनाओं की मांग मजबूत हो रही है। विशेषज्ञों के मुताबिक, प्रीमियम हाउसिंग, कमर्शियल स्पेस और लॉन्ग-टर्म कैपिटल एप्रिसिएशन की तलाश करने वाले खरीदारों के लिए NCR के ये उभरते क्षेत्र आकर्षक विकल्प बनते जा रहे हैं। आने वाले महीनों में ट्रांसपोर्ट लिंक मजबूत होने से कीमतों में और तेजी की संभावना जताई जा रही है।

records.title: गुड़गांव और फरीदाबाद में रियल एस्टेट के लिए नई उम्मीदें, एक्सप्रेसवे और मेट्रो कनेक्टिविटी से बढ़ेगी मांग
records.description: एनसीआर के प्रॉपर्टी बाजार में बुनियादी ढांचे की तेज़ रफ्तार अब रियल एस्टेट सेक्टर के लिए नए अवसर खोल रही है। हालिया खबरों में एक्सप्रेसवे विस्तार, मेट्रो लिंक और बेहतर कनेक्टिविटी के चलते आसपास के हाउसिंग और कमर्शियल कॉरिडोर में निवेशकों की दिलचस्पी बढ़ने के संकेत मिल रहे हैं। गुरुग्राम जैसे प्रीमियम बाजारों में ऑफिस स्पेस, लग्जरी आवास और हाई-स्ट्रीट रिटेल की मांग मजबूती से बनी हुई है, जबकि फरीदाबाद में किफायती आवास और इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर-आधारित विकास परियोजनाएं खरीदारों को आकर्षित कर रही हैं। नई सड़क परियोजनाएं, यात्रा समय में कमी और शहरी विस्तार आने वाले महीनों में दोनों शहरों में प्रॉपर्टी वैल्यू को सहारा दे सकते हैं।

records.title: दिल्ली-एनसीआर में 30 अप्रैल को बदल सकता है निवेश का परिदृश्य, गुरुग्राम और फरीदाबाद कनेक्टिविटी पर नजर
records.description: दिल्ली-एनसीआर में 30 अप्रैल को कई बड़े इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर फैसलों और रियल एस्टेट से जुड़े संकेतों पर बाजार की नजर रहेगी। क्षेत्र में कनेक्टिविटी सुधार, तेज़ आवागमन और ट्रांजिट हब विकास से गुरुग्राम और फरीदाबाद दोनों के प्रॉपर्टी बाज़ार को फायदा मिलने की उम्मीद है। गुरुग्राम में कॉर्पोरेट और लग्जरी हाउसिंग की मांग पहले से मजबूत है, जबकि फरीदाबाद में किफायती आवास और सड़क नेटवर्क सुधार निवेशकों को आकर्षित कर सकता है। बेहतर एक्सप्रेसवे लिंक, स्टेशन-आधारित विकास और शहरी विस्तार से आवासीय व कमर्शियल दोनों सेगमेंट में नई संभावनाएं बन सकती हैं। विशेषज्ञ मानते हैं कि ऐसे इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर अपडेट एनसीआर के रियल एस्टेट सेंटिमेंट को मजबूत करते हैं।

records.title: हॉर्मुज खुलते ही D-Street में राहत, सोमवार को रियल एस्टेट और बाजार सेंटीमेंट संभलने के संकेत

records.title: दिल्ली-देहरादून एक्सप्रेसवे के बाद एनसीआर रियल एस्टेट में नई उम्मीद, बढ़ सकती है गुरुग्राम की कनेक्टिविटी वैल्यू
records.description: दिल्ली-देहरादून एक्सप्रेसवे के शुरू होने के बाद एनसीआर के रियल एस्टेट बाजार में कनेक्टिविटी आधारित मांग और निवेश का नया रुझान दिख रहा है। हालांकि यह खबर सीधे किसी प्रोजेक्ट लॉन्च से जुड़ी नहीं है, लेकिन एक्सप्रेसवे नेटवर्क के विस्तार से गुरुग्राम और आसपास के कॉरिडोर में आवासीय, कमर्शियल और वेयरहाउसिंग संपत्तियों की अपील बढ़ने की संभावना है। तेज सड़क संपर्क से ऑफिस जाने वालों, लॉन्ग-टर्म निवेशकों और डेवलपर्स—तीनों के लिए अवसर बनते हैं। खासतौर पर उन क्षेत्रों को फायदा मिल सकता है जहां दिल्ली-एनसीआर से आसान पहुंच, भविष्य की ट्रैफिक राहत और बेहतर टोल-सिस्टम की उम्मीद है। ऐसे इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर अपग्रेड आमतौर पर जमीन की कीमतों, किराये की मांग और नए प्रोजेक्ट लॉन्च को समर्थन देते हैं।

records.title: एनसीआर रियल एस्टेट को नई रफ्तार: दिल्ली-देहरादून एक्सप्रेसवे और जेवर कनेक्टिविटी से निवेश की चमक बढ़ी

records.title: होर्मुज संकट से तेल-रसद पर दबाव, NCR रियल एस्टेट लागत को भी मिल सकता है झटका
records.description: ईरान-अमेरिका तनाव के बीच होर्मुज जलडमरूमध्य पर बढ़ते जोखिम ने वैश्विक तेल सप्लाई और शिपिंग लागत को अचानक ऊपर धकेल दिया है। क्रूड कीमतों में उतार-चढ़ाव का असर फ्यूल, ट्रांसपोर्ट और निर्माण सामग्री की लागत पर पड़ सकता है, जिसका सीधा प्रभाव रियल एस्टेट डेवलपमेंट पर दिख सकता है। एनसीआर में वे प्रोजेक्ट सबसे पहले प्रभावित हो सकते हैं जिनकी निर्भरता बड़े पैमाने पर लॉजिस्टिक्स और आयातित सामग्री पर है। दूसरी ओर, इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर लिंक, एक्सप्रेसवे कनेक्टिविटी और बेहतर ट्रांसपोर्ट नेटवर्क वाले कॉरिडोर निवेशकों के लिए अपेक्षाकृत मजबूत विकल्प बने रह सकते हैं। ऐसे माहौल में डेवलपर्स और खरीदारों दोनों की नजर लागत स्थिरता और डिलीवरी टाइमलाइन पर टिक गई है।

records.title: यूपी का नेशनल हाइवे बना नया प्रॉपर्टी हॉटस्पॉट, कम कीमत और बढ़ती मांग से निवेशकों की नजर

records.title: गुरुग्राम में 32nd Avenue बना जांच के घेरे में, कमर्शियल रियल एस्टेट हब पर ED की छापेमारी से बढ़ी हलचल
records.description: गुरुग्राम का 32nd Avenue, जिसे शहर के मॉल कल्चर से पहले उभरे एक प्रमुख कमर्शियल हब के रूप में देखा जाता था, अब प्रवर्तन निदेशालय (ED) की जांच के कारण चर्चा में है। एजेंसी ने 500 करोड़ रुपये की कथित मनी लॉन्ड्रिंग और प्रॉपर्टी फ्रॉड मामले में ग्रुप के कई ठिकानों पर दिल्ली-एनसीआर और गोवा सहित अलग-अलग स्थानों पर छापेमारी की। जांच के दौरान एक ही संपत्ति को कई बार बेचने और फर्जी दस्तावेजों के इस्तेमाल के आरोप सामने आए हैं। प्रमोटर ध्रुव शर्मा की गिरफ्तारी ने मामले को और गंभीर बना दिया है। इस घटनाक्रम से गुरुग्राम के प्रीमियम कमर्शियल रियल एस्टेट से जुड़े निवेशकों और डेवलपर्स के बीच सतर्कता बढ़ सकती है।

records.description: ग्रेटर नोएडा में एक लंबित आवासीय परियोजना को रफ्तार मिलने जा रही है, जिससे हजारों घर खरीदारों को बड़ी राहत मिल सकती है। 770 करोड़ रुपये के निवेश से जुड़े इस प्रोजेक्ट को अब आवश्यक मंजूरी मिल गई है, जिसके बाद निर्माण कार्य दोबारा तेज होने की उम्मीद है। रियल एस्टेट सेक्टर में यह फैसला इस बात का संकेत है कि NCR में अटकी परियोजनाओं को लेकर नियामक और प्रशासनिक रुख अब अधिक सक्रिय हो रहा है। परियोजना के आगे बढ़ने से न सिर्फ फ्लैट्स की डिलीवरी का रास्ता खुलेगा, बल्कि आसपास के इलाके में आवासीय मांग और निवेश गतिविधियों को भी समर्थन मिलेगा। ग्रेटर नोएडा में बुनियादी ढांचे और कनेक्टिविटी के विस्तार के बीच यह मंजूरी प्रॉपर्टी मार्केट के लिए सकारात्मक संकेत मानी जा रही है।

records.description: प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी की अपील के बाद रियल एस्टेट डेवलपर्स के शीर्ष संगठन क्रेडाई ने अपना वार्षिक सम्मेलन बेंगलुरु या देश के किसी घरेलू केंद्र की तरह भारत में आयोजित करने का फैसला किया है, जबकि इसे पहले एम्स्टर्डम में कराने की योजना थी। इस कदम को भारतीय प्रॉपर्टी सेक्टर के लिए सकारात्मक संकेत माना जा रहा है, क्योंकि इससे घरेलू निवेशकों, डेवलपर्स और नीति-निर्माताओं के बीच सीधा संवाद बढ़ेगा। उद्योग जगत का मानना है कि ऐसे मंचों से हाउसिंग डिमांड, अर्बन इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर और रियल एस्टेट निवेश के नए अवसरों पर चर्चा को गति मिलेगी। भारत में आयोजन से न केवल सेक्टर की वैश्विक छवि मजबूत होगी, बल्कि स्थानीय बाजारों में कारोबारी भरोसा भी बढ़ सकता है।

records.title: दिल्ली-NCR में रियल एस्टेट की रफ्तार तेज, एक्सप्रेसवे कनेक्टिविटी से निवेशकों की नजर अब नए हॉटस्पॉट पर
records.description: दिल्ली-NCR में रियल एस्टेट बाजार को एक्सप्रेसवे, मेट्रो और एयरपोर्ट कनेक्टिविटी से लगातार सहारा मिल रहा है। News18 की ताजा कारोबारी रिपोर्ट्स के मुताबिक, गाजियाबाद जैसे पड़ोसी इलाकों में कम बजट में लग्जरी लाइफस्टाइल और बेहतर कनेक्टिविटी के कारण निवेशकों की दिलचस्पी बढ़ी है। वहीं गंगा एक्सप्रेसवे और दिल्ली-मेरठ संपर्क जैसे प्रोजेक्ट्स ने जमीन और आवासीय संपत्तियों की मांग को नई धार दी है। NCR के कई हिस्सों में प्रॉपर्टी कीमतों में तेजी देखी जा रही है, जिससे मध्यम और प्रीमियम दोनों सेगमेंट में खरीदारी का माहौल मजबूत हुआ है। मौजूदा रुझान बताता है कि इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर-आधारित विकास अगले कुछ महीनों में रियल एस्टेट की दिशा तय करेगा, खासकर उन क्षेत्रों में जहां यात्रा समय घट रहा है और रोजगार केंद्रों तक पहुंच आसान हो रही है।

records.description: दिल्ली-NCR के रियल एस्टेट बाजार में कनेक्टिविटी-आधारित विकास एक बार फिर कीमतों को ऊपर ले जा रहा है। News18 Hindi की बिजनेस कवरेज में गंगा एक्सप्रेसवे, दिल्ली-मेरठ, एयरपोर्ट-मेट्रो और नए रोड नेटवर्क जैसे इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर प्रोजेक्ट्स को आवासीय और निवेश मांग बढ़ाने वाला कारक बताया गया है। ग्रेटर एनसीआर के कई इलाकों में प्रॉपर्टी दरों में तेज उछाल देखा जा रहा है, जबकि नोएडा, गाजियाबाद और फरीदाबाद जैसे विकल्प निवेशकों की रडार पर हैं। खासकर उन इलाकों में जहां बेहतर सड़कीय संपर्क, मेट्रो विस्तार और एक्सप्रेसवे लिंकिंग मिल रही है, वहां प्लॉट, फ्लैट और टाउनशिप प्रोजेक्ट्स की मांग तेज हुई है। विशेषज्ञों के मुताबिक, आने वाले महीनों में किफायती और मध्यम आय वर्ग के खरीदारों के लिए सही माइक्रो-मार्केट चुनना अहम होगा।
